name: h
description: Portable Kie-only batch and single-call workflow for text, image, and video generation.

interface.shortDescription: Kie text, image, and video work in concurrent batch or single mode.
interface.longDescription: H runs Kie-only workflows in two modes: recursive whole-folder batch processing and one-model single processing. It reverse-prompts with Kie multimodal text models, submits all eligible PID items concurrently, saves task IDs for safe resume, validates downloaded media, writes Desktop text/image/video folders, and bootstraps one reusable user-level Python environment on Windows and Intel or Apple Silicon macOS.
defaultPrompt: 使用 H 批量处理整个 PID 产品文件夹。
使用 H 单独调用一个 Kie 文本、图像或视频模型。
使用 H 继续已保存的 Kie 生成任务。
